## About
Northridge Collision Center is a collision repair shop at 8331 Balboa Blvd. Our courteous, multi-lingual staff will walk you through both the insurance side and the repair side of your car's repairs, so you know what is happening at each step.
We use Car-O-Liner measuring and straightening systems, PPG computerized paint mixing, MIG welders and Chief alignment machines so your car is repaired to its specifications. All paint work is done with E.P.A approved refinish materials.
We are rated 4.2 on Google from 52 reviews. Give us a call or stop by Monday through Friday.

## Services
- Body and paint repair: Collision body work and refinishing, backed by a lifetime written warranty.
- Free damage assessment: Have your damage looked at at no cost. Call the office to set up an appointment.
- Emergency towing: Towing is available around the clock, any day of the week.
- Rental cars: Rental cars at reduced rates while yours is in the shop.
- Shuttle service: Need a ride while your car is with us? Call the office.
- Glass replacement: Affordable glass replacement. Call the office for an appointment.
- Alignment: Alignment work on our Chief alignment machines.
- Auto detail: Experienced auto detailing. Call the office for an appointment.

## FAQ
Q: Will you deal with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work directly with your insurance company, and our staff will walk you through both the insurance side and the repair side.

Q: Do you work with Allstate?
A: Yes, we are an Allstate service provider.

Q: How do I get a damage assessment?
A: Damage assessments are free. Call our office to set one up.

Q: Is the shop easy to reach from the freeway?
A: Yes. From the 118, take the Balboa South exit.
